lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Good morning, you're welcome to Harmattan Microfinance Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and compliance purposes. My name is Funmi.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Good morning. I applied for the SME loan for my provisions shop, I wan know the terms.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: No problem. Before we go further, please confirm the last four digits of your BVN and your date of birth.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: BVN ends in 4471, date of birth 14 March 1988.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Thank you, Madam Aisha, you're verified. You've been approved for ₦500,000 over six months, interest at 4% flat per month.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Okay. So wetin I go dey pay every month?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: About ₦103,000 monthly. Honestly ma, I can only hold this approval until we end this call. If you drop, e don go.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Ehen, okay, let's do it. I accept.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Wonderful, I've booked it. You'll receive ₦455,000 in your account within the hour.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Yes ma, there's a 7.5% management fee and 1.5% credit life insurance, deducted upfront. That one na standard.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Nobody tell me that one before. I no happy at all.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: E dey for the terms and conditions, ma. Anything else?
